jobs_results.title: Senior Python Developer - Innovative IoT Solutions
jobs_results.description:
Description

Worldsensing products have been pioneering the industrial IoT since 2008. We’re looking for a stand-out Software Engineer to join the Engineering department in our Barcelona office.

About Worldsensing

Founded in 2008, Worldsensing works with more than 300 engineering partners worldwide to improve geotechnical, geospatial and structural monitoring in mining, construction, rail and critical infrastructure management.

With over 1,000 monitoring networks deployed worldwide and connecting over 65,000 sensors to the Internet of Things, our Loadsensing solution is the leader in the IoT remote monitoring space.

The Loadsensing monitoring solution includes best-in-class edge devices and LoRa-based connectivity products. We also join forces with key industry players to offer software applications and solutions which engineering service providers use to add value to end customers.

The Mission:

The Software Engineer is a critical role in WorldSensing. This role’s primary focus... is the development, definition, and deployment of software solutions for our products, whilst ensuring high performance and responsiveness to requests from and to these products.

Responsibilities:
• Design, development, and delivery of the company’s core platform and cloud applications, making sure our applications function properly (including scalability, efficiency, resilience, fault tolerance, and data security techniques).
• Work closely with other engineers & designers, product owners, and other team members to implement complex end-to-end systems.
• Use technical skills to close the gaps between new requirements and Worldsensing products.
• Build reusable code and libraries for future use.
• Rigorous commitment to documentation, quality engineering, testing, and support.
• Perform code reviews for other software engineers and provide feedback.
• On-call support may be required to support a 24/7 online service.
• Collaborate and help in the definition of European Union Innovation projects.

Requirements
• 5+ years of software development experience in back-end services.
• 3+ years with Python using FastAPI framework.
• Experience with Java, React and TypeScript is a plus.
• Experience with advanced programming frameworks and paradigms.
• Good experience with Linux environments.
• Experience with Docker.
• Experience with Kubernetes is a plus.
• Basic networking knowledge.
• Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, preferably Git.
• You're passionate about IoT & technical challenges. There should be something you know more about than anyone on our team.
• Strong analysis and practical problem-solving abilities to resolve challenging situations.
• You communicate with clarity and precision. We care about this almost as much as your technical ability.
• You’re an empathetic person who is comfortable with changes and is an incredibly fast learner and has a can-do, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude.
• BS degree in a technical field or equivalent experience.
• A good level of spoken and written English is required.

Competencies:
• Be able to develop in different programming languages.
• Ability to organize work with little day-to-day direction.
• Track record of flexibility in response to changing circumstances.
• A good team player with excellent verbal and written skills along with a strong commercial focus.
• A can-do, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude.
• Passion for your work and a sense of humor.

Benefits
• Great work environment: we are a passionate, tight-knit team hailing from 20+ countries
• We are a family-friendly company and support a healthy work-life balance, we’re outcome oriented
• Work-from-home policy (flexibility)
• We like grabbing lunch or a drink together, and coming together for fun events organized by Worldsensing
• We love to learn and we love to share so you will actively participate in our knowledge sharing initiatives or transversal committees (communities, show and tell, etc.)
• You can expect a competitive compensation package
• Opportunity to work for a global IoT player which has been labeled as one of the organizations actively shaping and pioneering the Industrial Internet
• Hybrid working environment

At Worldsensing, we’re committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We strive to be a more equal opportunity workplace

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, C++ and Python
jobs_results.description:
C++/Python Programmer in Disease and Health-care Process Simulation Modelling

Location: Europe, (Flexible, Remote)

Overview:
• The Core Diabetes Model is a disease-simulation model used to inform health policy decisions and conduct economic evaluations for interventions aimed at controlling diabetes by delaying the occurrence of its complications.
• You will play an integral role in supporting the team expand the model in new, related therapeutic areas, as well as optimizing its use in the C++ environment and/or transfer to a new platform
• Further you will support in the development of new disease simulation models
• If you are interested in disease and health-care processes simulation modelling and wish to apply your technical skills to help inform healthcare decision making, this is the role for you!

Essential Functions
• C++ /Python programmer focused on maintaining and developing a disease-simulation software in these platforms.
• Understand and be able to code complex... statistical regression models (linear, logistic survival with time-varying inputs) to predict clinical endpoints (such as QRisk® https://qrisk.org)
• Communicate and share results to lay audiences (perform cross-validations in MS Excel, prepare technical reports in MSWord and/or PPT, contribute to manuscripts writing, and communication with clients).

Requirements
• BSc degree in Medical/Biomedical sciences/engineering, or mathematics
• Demonstrable interest in population health science, public health, epidemiology
• Experience in disease modelling, healthcare analytics and/or medical statistics: strong understanding of survival analysis, logistic regression, and mathematical models within life science applications
• Excellent programming skills in Python and C++. Experience with the software development lifecycle including requirements definition, specification capture, software architecture/design, program development, associated documentation, test automation, and maintenance.
• Experience with typical industry tools including standard libraries and frameworks, interactive development environments, software version control, build systems, automated testing frameworks, and bug tracking systems.
• An energetic, enthusiastic, pro-active, problem-solving attitude
• Strong oral and written communication skills in English
• Effective at collaborating remotely with colleagues.

What We Offer
• Have a pivotal role in the development of the most used and validated health-care decision model to date (over 120 Medline listed publications), preferred and used by health-technology assessment bodies around the World.
• Opportunity to learn and apply your skills in other therapeutic areas of health-economic modelling such as, modelling of infectious diseases, building discrete event simulations to optimize healthcare resource allocation and processes.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. We believe in pushing the boundaries of human science and data science to make the biggest impact possible – to help our customers create a healthier world. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

jobs_results.description:
Hello! 👋

We know that you are looking for a new challenge, yes, don't deny it, you are exploring new projects, offers and companies, therefore, something you would like to change🤭.

Who are we?

First of all, people are the most important value for us, secondly, we are people who love technology 💙🦾, we are tekkies, we like it, even if it has nothing to do with our job, those geeky novelties that make us spend hours watching on youtube, twitch, tik tok, GitLab or whatever.

We are a leading consultancy firm in the technology sector with national and international clients. This year is our 30th year of existence, with a 30% growth in our turnover and more than 2,500 people in our team. We are a different company, a company where people come first and where meritocracy prevails.

knowmad mood is Microsoft Gold Partner with 5 competencies:

- Gold Application Development

- Gold Cloud Platform

- Gold Application Integration

- Silver DevOps

- Silver Data Analytics

What are we... looking for?

The company is seeking an experienced Software Engineer with cybersecurity, Generative AI, and Python development expertise. This critical role involves designing and implementing systems to enhance the capabilities of cybersecurity professionals.

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to developing cutting-edge Generative AI systems to enhance the capabilities of cybersecurity analysts.
• Write secure efficient and scalable Python code from design to production in cloud native product.
• Contributing to technological and architectural decisions with the ability to take a leading role.
• Collaborate with interdisciplinary and remotely distributed teams, promoting a culture of technical excellence and innovation in cybersecurity and artificial intelligence.
• Stay updated on the latest cybersecurity threats and technological advancements, ensuring our solutions are fortified against emerging threats.

Nice to have:
• A minimum of 5 years of experience in software development with an emphasis on cybersecurity and Generative AI.
• Mastery in Python programming (Django).
• Experience with CI/CD/DevOps, Git.
• Comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat modeling, and secure coding practices.
• Experience in developing secure applications with cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)>
• Experience with API development and integration, particularly cyber security products (SIEM, EDR, etc.)
• A Bachelor's or Master degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field is preferred.

⏰ Full Time Position (Spain: 12:00h - 19:00h Aprox. GMT+1)

Going to work is not just about looking at emails and dealing with requests. Can you imagine doing a virtual escape room with your colleagues or joining a chess club? Throughout the year we do 𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐦 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 activities for all. 🎮♟

If you have a friend you can't get rid of, get them to join us! If you think you fit any of our profiles and join us you will get a prize 🤑 🤑 🤑.

And if all this is not enough for you, we have many surprises that we are carrying out throughout the year.

Are you ready to face new challenges?

Join our more than 2,500 professionals and become part of a nice story in knowmad mood
